messages:
Jordan (sales): Hey team — Asteria Bank verbally agreed to a pilot. Need help scoping the POC: streaming + function calls + structured JSON output. Also they asked about on-prem/Dedicated pricing and KMS integration. Can we prioritize?
Priya (SE): Congrats. Key asks from them: VPC-only demo, transactional JSON schema (see below), function call to their 'risk-check' service, 200 QPS sustained, <120ms p50 preferred.
Sam (eng): Quick questions: is the 200 QPS per tenant or across all convo streams? Also do they require strict ordering for KV cache reuse?
Jordan (sales): Per-tenant. They have 3 environments initially (dev/stage/prod) — prod target is the 200 QPS.
Priya (SE): For structured output, they want each message to produce a single top-level 'transaction' JSON. Example expected: 
```json
{
  "transaction_id": "uuid",
  "amount": 119.95,
  "currency": "USD",
  "merchant": {"id": "m_123", "name": "Acme"},
  "fraud_score": 0.12,
  "actions": [{"type":"approve"}|{"type":"escalate","reason":"..."}]
}
```
Sam (eng): That maps well to our structured-output schema. For streaming + tool calls we'd recommend streaming RPC with function-call metadata in the SSE/frame header. Example Node snippet for their SDK: 
```js
// simplified
const stream = client.stream({model: 'redwood-stream-1', mode: 'transactions'});
stream.on('data', chunk => {
  // chunk.toolCalls -> call their risk-check
  // chunk.structured -> parsed transaction object
});
// on handshake, include: X-Tenant-ID, X-Env
```
Sam (eng): Important infra notes: to hit 200 QPS with <120ms p50 we recommend dedicated reserved pool (min 4 GPUs depending on model) or smart routing to a lower-cost variant for background/non-prod traffic. We'll need to pin model version to avoid cold-start regressions.
Marta (product): We should propose an alpha config: Dedicated dev=1 GPU, stage=2 GPUs (auto-burst), prod=4 GPUs reserved. Include a fallback policy to hosted-pool with a cheaper quantized model if capacity is exhausted.
Jordan (sales): Pricing ask from procurement: what's the delta between hosted and Dedicated for their commit size (3 envs, baseline 200 QPS prod)? Can Finance draft a ballpark so legal/procurement can move?
FinanceBot: Estimated monthly commit (preserve 99% of prod availability): Dedicated capacity + support = $44,000/mo (ballpark). Hosted fallback option reduces commit to $29,000/mo but with higher per-token costs during fallback. (This is illustrative - SE/Eng to validate sizing).
Emma (security): Security checklist: they require SOC2, data separation, KMS with customer-managed keys, VPC peering or PrivateLink, audit logs for model inputs/outputs, and option for on-prem bundle for regulated data. Also their InfoSec will send our security questionnaire (likely ~60 Qs).
Priya (SE): We need to confirm: do they expect logs of full model outputs to be stored? If yes, encryption-at-rest + redaction pipeline required.
Jordan (sales): They want full auditability for the prod lane but are open to redaction of PII in logs; they'll review our redaction capabilities.
Sam (eng): For KMS, we support external KMS integrations (AWS KMS/HSM). On-prem package can run a private control plane; we'll need a 2-week install window for their infra team plus network whitelist.
Marta (product): Action items: 1) SE to prepare runbook + demo env spec, 2) Eng to produce a streaming handshake example and latency throughput estimate, 3) Security to pre-fill the questionnaire and flag any gaps, 4) Finance to produce formal pricing tiers (hosted vs reserved commits vs on-prem).
Priya (SE): I'll assemble the runbook template and a minimal demo manifest. Link to our presales checklist: https://redwood.example/presales/runbook (internal). Will include a sample valid/invalid transaction set for their eval.
Jordan (sales): Timeline from customer: want POC in 4 weeks. Is that doable?
Sam (eng): 4 weeks is tight but doable if we parallelize: SE sets up VPC demo, Eng prepares a baseline dedicated sizing test (we can run internal perf for 200 QPS), Security starts questionnaire. If any infra delays, fallback to hosted demo for week 1.
Emma (security): I'll start the SQA draft and send the link. Expect follow-ups on retention, keys, and export controls.
Jordan (sales): Thanks everyone. SE/Eng/Security — can we sync on a 30-min call tomorrow? I'll add calendar invite. 
Priya (SE): Sure — will bring sample schema + sample curl/websocket examples.
Sam (eng): I'll bring perf numbers and a simple stress harness command: `k6 run --vus 200 --duration 60s stream-test.js` :thumbsup:
Jordan (sales): Perfect. I'll confirm the invite and paste the customer's security contacts after the call.
Emma (security): Noted.
Marta (product): I'll prepare a one-pager showing fallback behaviors and quantization tradeoffs to include in the proposal.
Jordan (sales): Great — thanks team.
